notes: 1977 office block used as police bureau on the Lijnbaansgracht (south-west, bearing 232). Described from the 2021-01-22 panorama (w01-232.jpg, rectified, 24 m): dark brown brick, regular grid of small-pane dark-framed windows with white sills and lintel flashes. Left tall block = panel 32 (surface 34, 14.1 m, 19.9 m high, 5 rows, 6 axes); right wing = panel 28 (surfaces 30/39, 15.7 m, 4 rows, about 12 axes) with a setback fifth row above it (panel 37, surfaces 40/53).

Ornaments from the panorama: white projecting band under the fourth row of the left block (stringCourses: simplified, a course per storey on the wing instead of the single 2 m band); round street sign and red plate at the left ground corner (skipped: 0.3-0.4 m wall plates carry no text legible at gallery size and sit below the 5 cm attachment grain); ground-level canopy at the far left (skipped: the entrance lies outside the rectified wall, no evidence of its shape); no POLITIE lettering, blue lamp, striped band or crest on the building (the only POLITIE in the frame is the livery of a parked van, street furniture not building).
Rear/NE, SE and NW walls and courtyard faces have no panorama in the cache and are left to otherWalls (blank; audit:glb warns blank-wall for them).
